propositions: The generic reads-under-contention property accepts shape-valid but content-hollow payloads (missing ticket_id) on all four surfaces (show/list/search/ready) when it should reject them.

Seeded faults F3 (show emits {}, exit 0) and F6 (show emits record without ticket_id, exit 0) pass the current property but fail the regression test test_show_no_stall.py::test_cli_show_complete_or_erroring_under_write_burst.
The current _assert_complete_or_loud check stops at isinstance(doc, expected_shape) without verifying that returned records carry truthy ticket_id values.

Per-surface content-completeness predicates must be added to enforce that show returns objects with truthy ticket_id and list/search/ready return dicts each with truthy ticket_id (valid-empty [] remains acceptable).
